name: Wei Chuan USA
old_description: For over five decades, Wei-Chuan USA's passion for delicious food has allowed our customers to enjoy authentic Chinese flavors: every recipe balances tradition with innovation to make meals that everyone can enjoy.
about:
Wei Chuan USA was founded in 1972 in Los Angeles, California, by brothers Thomas and Robert Huang, who had recently immigrated from Taiwan and missed the authentic flavors of home. The company’s name, meaning “comprehensive flavors” in Chinese, reflects its mission to bridge cultures through food. Headquarters are now located in Murfreesboro, Tennessee.

The company operates two USDA Grant of Inspection and FDA-approved manufacturing facilities — one in Los Angeles and a second established in Tennessee in 2006 — both running certified HACCP, GMP, and SSOP programs. Its product lines span gyoza, potstickers, spring rolls, egg rolls, buns, dumplings, wontons, wrappers, entrée items, shumai, natural and organic selections, groceries, and food-service packs. An in-house R&D team of food scientists, nutritionists, and chefs develops and tests every recipe.

Wei Chuan serves retail grocery chains, food-service distributors, and consumers across North America. Its Food Service and Groceries categories supply restaurants, institutions, and supermarkets, while the Natural, Organic, and Vegetarian line targets health-conscious shoppers. The Dumpling King series, launched in the early 1990s, remains a flagship retail product.

The founders started the business because authentic Chinese flavors were unavailable in the U.S. market. Today, Wei Chuan emphasizes continuous investment in technology, rigorous quality control, and recipes that balance tradition with innovation, aiming to make “comprehensive flavors” accessible to every household.
